parts.note_add: S-001 p16: the cluster is fed GY from the 10 A meter fuse (IG) and grounded B to X-13 through two 13-cavity round connectors X-05 and X-06; the oil-level, stop-light and alternator warning lamps are linked by diodes inside the printed plate so the alternator lamp circuit also lights them (bulb check). 1982 cluster carries an oil pressure gauge and a voltmeter beside fuel/temp.

1985 manual (S-002 15-22) disassembly order: front lens, plate, voltmeter and oil gauge, tachometer, speedometer, fuel and temp gauge, warning lights lens, meter case, printed plate, bulbs; 1982 order not given, confirm.
Electronic tachometer: GY feed, B ground, signal YG from the trailing ignition coil negative (S-001 p16, section B); the K-008 fault analysis traces its flicker to the shared X-13 ground.
Cable-driven; 1985 manual says a fluctuating or dead needle is checked by removing the cable first, and only if the cable is good is the speedometer replaced.
Used OEM FB cables are sold by salvage specialists; the listed fit claims 1979-85 both transmissions, confirm length against the car.

Both are thermal (bimetal heater-coil) gauges fed from PT624 and grounded through their resistive senders: fuel on Y to C-01, temperature on YW to C-02 (S-001 p16). Factory test: substitute the sender with checker 49 0839 285 and wait 2 minutes.

S-001 p16: input GY (IG), output to the fuel and water temperature gauges only, ground B via X-05; the oil pressure gauge, tachometer and voltmeter take GY directly, unregulated. Output voltage is not given in any source opened.

E-05 rheostat (S-001 p20): RG in from the light switch tail circuit, RL out to the dimmed illumination lamps (meter, heater, select lever, switch panel, lighter), B to X-13 via X-02; the radio and stereo lamps take RG directly and are not dimmed.

Trade 194: 14 V 0.27 A T3-1/4 miniature wedge W2.1x9.5d (Eiko datasheet); factory rates it 3.4 W. On the 1982 cluster it lights the meter illumination and the oil level, high beam and retractor indicators (S-001 p16, p20).
Trade 74: 14 V 0.1 A T1-3/4 sub-miniature wedge W2.1x4.9d (Eiko datasheet); factory 1.4 W, used for the brake, stop light, alternator and coolant level warning lamps (S-001 p16).
